minutes.headline: Board of Health unanimously granted three septic variances (West St Terrace, West Acres Dr, 84 Field St) and reelected its officers.
minutes.summary: The Board of Health met by Zoom for the last time before returning to in-person meetings. It granted three Title 5 local upgrade variances, adding conditions on a pump replacement and raised plumbing outlets. It reorganized for the year, discussed COVID mask guidance, and noted the Shady Point porta-potty arrangement.

votes.motion: Grant the two variances for 9 West Street Terrace (groundwater separation and tank/foundation distance) with added requirement that the pump be replaced
Grant the variances requested for 8 West Acres Drive as asked
Grant the variances for 84 Field Street based on the agent's recommendations, including raising the plumbing outlet
Nominate George Eamon as chairman for another year
Nominate Perry Jewell as vice chairman
Nominate Paul Fortin as scribe for another year

decisions.decision: Variances for 9 West Street Terrace approved on condition the septic pump is replaced.
Raising the basement plumbing to lift the outlet was made part of the 84 Field Street motion.
No vote required for the Shady Point rolling porta-potty schedule; it continues as in past years.
Chair, vice chair and scribe reappointed for the coming year.

what_happened.line: The Board of Health voted to grant two septic variances for 9 West Street Terrace, on the added condition that the pump be replaced.
The board granted the variances requested for 8 West Acres Drive as asked, unanimously.
The board granted the variances for 84 Field Street on the agent's recommendations, with raised basement plumbing made part of the motion.
The chair, vice chair and scribe were reappointed for the coming year.
The board took no vote on the Shady Point rolling porta-potty schedule, which continues as in past years.

why_it_matters: Septic variances decide how far a failing system on a lot can be upgraded, so the added pump and plumbing conditions set what those three property owners must install.
Board of Health decisions on septic systems and sanitation are local rules a resident may meet if they replace or repair their own system.
